en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b `Abdullah narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from `Isa al-Fara’ from `Abdullah b. Abi Ya`fur. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say: Abu Ja`far al-Baqir (as) said:
Whoever’s appearances are weightier [in deeds] than his inside, his Scale [of good deeds] will be lightened.
